data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for collecting noise and decibel levels from the phone's microphone.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that records PCM audio data using the device microphone and provides a stream of NoiseReading objects containing mean and maximum decibel levels. It supports both iOS and Android platforms.
use_when: You need to measure ambient noise or decibel levels in your Flutter application.
You want to stream real-time noise readings from the device microphone.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured audio recording and playback solution for music or voice memos.
Your project targets Flutter or platform versions older than the specified requirements.
strengths: Provides a simple stream-based API for noise readings.
Computes both mean and max decibel levels out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific permission configuration for Android and iOS.
Strict platform and Flutter version requirements.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding RECORD_AUDIO permission on Android, and Info.plist/Background Modes configuration on iOS.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose record if you need to record and save audio files to disk rather than streaming live decibel meters.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose audioplayers if your primary need is playing audio files or streams instead of analyzing microphone decibels.
